summary.text: Joey Smyth is the Democratic candidate for the Minnesota House of Representatives, District 30A, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Walter Hudson (R).
A retail manager, he says he is running on accountability, affordability and accessibility.

paragraphs.text: Joey Smyth earned a high school diploma from STMA High School, and his career experience includes retail management.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Smyth said he has spent his entire working career in retail and that the experience taught him leadership starts with listening.
He wrote that he decided to run after attending his first caucus, and he named economic policy, public health policy and education policy as the areas he is most passionate about.
